name: breathe
title: Breathe
description: Gentle guided breathing with a faint screen-edge color ring
author: aaron

commands.name: start-breathing
commands.title: Start Breathing
commands.description: Choose a breathing pattern and displays, then start the overlay

commands.name: toggle-breathing
commands.title: Toggle Breathing
commands.description: Start or stop breathing with your last-used settings

commands.name: install-login-start
commands.title: Enable Start at Login
commands.description: Start breathing automatically when you log in to macOS (no dev mode needed)

preferences.name: defaultPattern
preferences.title: Default Pattern
preferences.description: Pattern used when toggling without opening Start

preferences.name: customInhale
preferences.title: Custom inhale (seconds)
preferences.description: Inhale duration for the Custom pattern (minimum 1 second)

preferences.name: customHoldIn
preferences.title: Custom hold after inhale (seconds)
preferences.description: Hold after inhale for the Custom pattern; use 0 to skip this phase

preferences.name: customExhale
preferences.title: Custom exhale (seconds)
preferences.description: Exhale duration for the Custom pattern (minimum 1 second)

preferences.name: customHoldOut
preferences.title: Custom hold after exhale (seconds)
preferences.description: Hold after exhale for the Custom pattern; use 0 to skip this phase

preferences.name: ringOpacity
preferences.title: Ring opacity (0-100)
preferences.description: How visible the edge ring is; lower values are more subtle

preferences.name: ringWidth
preferences.title: Ring width (pixels)
preferences.description: Thickness of the colored edge band in pixels

preferences.name: defaultDisplays
preferences.title: Default displays
preferences.description: Which displays to pre-select when starting
